title: Magic Gate Teleportation: Structure, Useful Resource States, and Simpler Feedforward
summary: Quantum gate teleportation is a key technique in fault-tolerant quantum computation that uses resource states to implement logical gates. Here, we develop a theory of magic gate teleportation (MGT), a form of quantum gate teleportation that uses non-stabilizer resource states to implement non-Clifford unitary gates on arbitrary input states without revealing information about those states. This setting is motivated by the canonical approach to implementing logical non-Clifford gates in fault-tolerant quantum computation.
